title: 第2章 沈炼的不满
slug: 穿梭时空的侠客全本免费-穿梭时空的侠客最新章节列表
content_zh:
低沉的咳嗽声打断了陈浩的沉思，他连忙抬头看向发出声音的位置，映入眼帘的是一位二十四五岁的俊朗青年。
那青年正是沈炼，咳嗽声也是他故意发出的。
沈炼？见到眼前与张震颇为相似的青年，陈浩拍了拍有些发酸的手臂，急忙从地上爬了起来。
对于陈浩来说，他唯一不满意的就是这副被酒色掏空的身躯了，要知道在21世纪陈浩可是能连续做200多个俯卧撑，可是现在连50个都没能做到，期间还将俯卧撑换成了平板支撑这种简单动作！
看着眼前的沈炼，陈浩的心里升腾出一种莫名的亲切感，他知道这是来自原主人的情感，毕竟他已接收了沈长青的全部记忆。
“长青，你小子从广州回来也不先找我？”
沈炼又往前迈了一步，用拳头锤了两下陈浩的胸膛，话里虽然透着责怪之意，脸上的表情却倍显关切。
“咳，咳，大哥你轻点！”
陈浩被沈炼锤的直咧嘴，差点没摔倒在地上，英俊的脸上满是责备之色。
沈炼见陈浩这种弱不经风的表现，心中有些不满，刚才还满怀笑意的脸上瞬间又是冷若冰霜。
他们沈家一直是以武传家，祖上出过几员大将，父亲和叔叔也是锦衣卫中有名的好手，沈炼自认为他自己武力值也不错，偏偏这位堂弟，身材虽说比他还高一点，但是细皮嫩肉，手无缚鸡之力，一副被酒色掏空的样子。
被发现了？看到沈炼脸色忽变，陈浩以为沈炼发现了什么，不过随即又把这个想法从脑海中抹去了。
虽然沈长青小时候是沈炼的小跟屁虫，两兄弟的关系很好，不过后来沈一高被调去广州，这一去就是十年，期间两人并没有见过面，只写过几封书信而已，被认出来的难度太大了。
更何况他和沈长青的魂魄彻底融合在了一起，此方世界他陈浩就是沈长青。
“这位沈兄弟是大人的朋友？”
这时殷澄走至两人身前问道，看得出来他和沈炼关系不错，否则也不敢冒昧的问询上司。
“我堂弟！”沈炼叹了口气道，言语间颇有些恨铁不成钢。
“原来沈兄弟居然是大人的堂弟，大人和沈兄弟应该多年未见了吧，兄弟重逢应该好好庆祝一下，我去为大人准备好酒好菜！”
说罢殷澄便疾步走出了百户所，也不待沈炼点头。
陈浩默默给殷澄点了个赞，这殷澄察言观色的本事还是不错的，坏就坏在他那张臭嘴上，否则也不会被凌云凯整，更不会被逼的自尽于沈炼刀下！

陈浩并没有觉得沈炼无情，殷澄不死沈炼就可能被凌云凯整死，我不入地狱谁入地狱那只是小说中的意淫！
要怪只能怪大家都活在这该死的明末！
盏茶的功夫殷澄提着一个大食盒和两壶酒重新回到了百户所，而陈浩早就被沈炼带到了他的书房。
“我随便点了几样，也不知合不合大人的口味，大人请慢用。”
殷澄将食盒。
酒菜摆好殷澄便退了下去，沈炼两兄弟自然挽留了几句，不过殷澄手上尚有公事要处理。
“叔父几月过世的？”
沈炼给自己倒了杯酒一饮而尽，自进屋来第一次给陈浩好脸色。
殷澄准备饭菜这一段时间，两兄弟自然谈过些话，只是沈炼一直板着脸。
“上个月初七！”
陈浩哀声道，心中亦是十分难过，原主人对父亲的情感还是很深的，以至于陈浩备受影响。
“伯母还好吗？”
他也给自己倒了一杯酒，同样是一饮而尽。
沈炼摇了摇头，道：“母亲三个月前过世，咱们家族就剩我们兄弟二人了！”
又是一饮而尽，烈酒下肚并没有给沈炼带来一丝温暖，反而是无尽萧索扑面而来。
兄弟二人一杯接着一杯，沈炼是因为父母叔父皆亡故而伤心欲绝，而陈浩则回忆起这一世父亲的他的好，以及父亲去世前最大的心愿就是回一趟京城，见一下远在京城的亲人。
借酒消愁愁更愁，盏茶的功夫两壶酒已被兄弟二人喝光了，二人都有了些许醉意。
“你在广州呆了十年有余，身体怎么如此羸弱，难道叔父没教你武艺不成？”
喝掉最后一滴残存的酒液，沈炼猛地拍了下桌子，怒道：“五年前叔父写信，说你在广州吃喝嫖赌，不学无术，当时我还不信，现在看来叔父说的没错！”

content_en:
A low cough interrupted Chen Hao's contemplation. He quickly looked up at the place where the sound came from, and what came into view was a handsome young man in his mid-twenties.
That young man was Shen Lian, and he made the cough deliberately.
Shen Lian? Seeing the young man in front of him who looked very similar to Zhang Zhen, Chen Hao patted his sore arms and hurriedly got up from the ground.
For Chen Hao, the only thing he is dissatisfied with is his body that has been hollowed out by alcohol and sex. You must know that in the 21st century, Chen Hao could do more than 200 push-ups in a row, but now he cannot even do 50. During this period, he also replaced push-ups with simple movements such as planks!
Looking at Shen Lian in front of him, Chen Hao felt an inexplicable sense of intimacy in his heart. He knew that this was the emotion from the original owner. After all, he had received all of Shen Changqing's memories.
"Changqing, you didn't come to see me first when you came back from Guangzhou?"
Shen Lian took another step forward and hit Chen Hao's chest twice with his fist. Although his words contained blame, the expression on his face was doubly concerned.
"Cough, cough, brother, please be gentle!"
Chen Hao was so grinned by Shen Lian that he almost fell to the ground, his handsome face full of reproach.
Seeing Chen Hao's weak performance, Shen Lian felt a little dissatisfied, and his face that was full of smiles just now suddenly turned cold and frosty.
The Shen family has always been a descendant of martial arts. There have been several generals in their ancestors, and his father and uncle are also famous warriors in the Jinyi Guards. Shen Lian thinks that his own martial arts value is good, but this cousin, although a little taller than him, has thin skin and tender flesh, and his hands are not strong enough to restrain a chicken. He looks like he has been hollowed out by wine and sex.
Discovered? Seeing the sudden change in Shen Lian's face, Chen Hao thought that Shen Lian had discovered something, but then he erased the idea from his mind.
Although Shen Changqing was Shen Lian's little follower when he was a child, and the two brothers had a good relationship, later Shen Yigao was transferred to Guangzhou. He stayed there for ten years. During this period, the two did not meet each other and only wrote a few letters. It was too difficult to be recognized.
What's more, his and Shen Changqing's souls are completely integrated. In this world, Chen Hao is Shen Changqing.
"Is this Brother Shen your Lord's friend?"
At this time, Yin Cheng walked up to the two of them and asked. It could be seen that he had a good relationship with Shen Lian, otherwise he would not dare to ask his boss presumptuously.
"My cousin!" Shen Lian sighed, with a hint of hatred in his words.
"It turns out that Brother Shen is actually your cousin. You and Brother Shen must not have seen each other for many years. We should celebrate the reunion of brothers. I will prepare wine and food for you!"
After saying that, Yin Cheng quickly walked out of Baihusuo without waiting for Shen Lian to nod.
Chen Hao silently gave Yin Cheng a thumbs up. Yin Cheng's ability to observe people's emotions is quite good, but his bad thing is his bad mouth. Otherwise, he would not be punished by Ling Yunkai, nor would he be forced to commit suicide under Shen Lian's knife!
Chen Hao didn't feel that Shen Lian was ruthless. If Yin Cheng didn't die, Shen Lian might be tortured to death by Ling Yunkai. If I don't go to hell, who will? That's just obscenity in the novel!
The only thing to blame is that everyone is living in this damn late Ming Dynasty!
After making tea, Yin Cheng returned to Baihusuo carrying a large food box and two jugs of wine, while Chen Hao had already been taken to his study by Shen Lian.
"I ordered a few random things, but I don't know if they suit your taste. Please use them with caution."
Yin Cheng took the food box.
After the food and drinks were put on the table, Yin Cheng withdrew. Naturally, the two brothers Shen Lian stayed with him for a few words, but Yin Cheng still had business matters to deal with.
"In what month did my uncle pass away?"
Shen Lian poured himself a glass of wine and drank it in one gulp, giving Chen Hao a good look for the first time since entering the room.
While Yin Cheng was preparing the meal, the two brothers naturally had some conversations, but Shen Lian kept a straight face.
"The seventh day of last month!"
Chen Hao said sadly, feeling very sad in his heart. The original owner still had deep feelings for his father, so Chen Hao suffered a lot.Influence.
"Auntie, how are you?"
He also poured himself a glass of wine, which he also drank in one gulp.
Shen Lian shook his head and said: "My mother passed away three months ago, and we are the only two brothers left in our family!"
After drinking it all in one gulp, the strong drink did not bring any warmth to Shen Lian, but instead brought endless depression to his face.
The two brothers drank one glass after another. Shen Lian was heartbroken because his parents and uncles had died, while Chen Hao recalled how kind his father was in this life and that his father's biggest wish before his death was to return to the capital and see his relatives far away in the capital.
The two brothers drank up the two pots of wine in the time it took to make tea, and both of them were a little tipsy.
"You have been in Guangzhou for more than ten years. Why are you so weak? Could it be that your uncle didn't teach you martial arts?"
After drinking the last drop of the wine, Shen Lian slammed the table and said angrily: "Five years ago, my uncle wrote a letter saying that you were eating, drinking, whoring and gambling in Guangzhou, and you were uneducated and unskilled. I didn't believe it at the time, but now it seems that my uncle was right!"
